versions.name: RXV2-0.9.539-install-watchdog
versions.notes: Update safety: the receiver no longer goes deaf if a WiFi download stalls. A download that stops for 25 s is abandoned (firmware unchanged), a task watchdog reboots the receiver if anything else wedges during an install, and the events log now records each download's size and time. Handshake timeout trimmed to 20 s.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.538-esc-catcher-safe-wifi-first
versions.notes: Scorpion ESC editor: Save now confirms right above the button ("Saved - read back from the ESC and confirmed"). Boot catcher made safe: a stale arm survives software reboots but a transmitter heard at power-up cancels it (never freezes ESC telemetry at the field); Cancel button on the battery card. Updates prefer the receiver's own WiFi: if it is still joining, the app waits (up to 45 s) instead of pushing over Bluetooth - unless the home network is out of range.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.537-esc-release-by-effect
versions.notes: Scorpion ESC editor: Release now judges itself by effect - it retries the reset write and waits for the ESC's telemetry to come back (up to 20 s), reporting the live voltage - a lost acknowledgement no longer reads as a failed release. Idle status reads "Press Read the ESC to start".

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.536-esc-boot-catcher
versions.notes: Scorpion ESC editor: the receiver now catches the ESC by itself. A Scorpion only listens for a programmer in its first 10 s after power-up, so when the editor sees no answer it arms the receiver; pull the battery, wait 5 s, plug in, and the receiver asks the flight controller for the ESC settings during those first seconds - the phone only has to reconnect. First live read + verified write on the Goblin 770 (Tribunus II 14S-200A).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.535-esc-wire-switches
versions.notes: First-time basics: new Two-way ESC talk (half-duplex) and ESC pin swap switches next to the ESC telemetry protocol - the Scorpion editor needs both on a Nexus X (its ESC pad is the UART RX pin). Verified-write like the rest of the page.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.534-escprog-route
versions.notes: Fix: the ESC settings page was never routed on the receiver itself (404 since 0.9.530 - only the phone apps served it). Ships the same Scorpion editor as 0.9.533.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.533-esc-write
versions.notes: Scorpion ESC settings can now be CHANGED from the phone (beta): edit any field, Save writes only what changed and reads the ESC back to verify; Release reboots ESC + FC. Fixes: long MSP writes (84-byte ESC blob) were silently dropped (now chunked over CRSF); FC "MSP error" replies fail fast (502) instead of a 1.2 s timeout; battery-ritual guidance for the ESC listen window.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.532-no-starve
versions.notes: FLIGHT-SAFETY: MSP waits (web/BLE config requests) now keep the radio and channel output running - an erroring request could starve the FC into rhythmic failsafe twitches (found live during the first Scorpion read attempt).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.531-escprog-link
versions.notes: The wizard's ESC page now links straight to the Scorpion readout (beta) - it was only in A la carte.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.530-scorpion-readout
versions.notes: NEW (beta): ESC settings page reads a Scorpion Tribunus through the flight controller - every setting in plain English, no cables, no Windows. Read-only until hardware-verified; Release button reboots the ESC so telemetry returns.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.529-timings-in-seconds
versions.notes: Governor timings now displayed in SECONDS (converted to Rotorflight's tenths on the wire) - the tenths trap caused a 40-second spool-up on the Goblin's second flight.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.528-govmode-bubble
versions.notes: Governor-mode bubble corrected to RF 2.3's real modes (OFF/LIMIT/DIRECT/ELECTRIC/NITRO) - ELECTRIC is the right choice for electric helis; the old text used RF1 names.
